title: Nutty Charred Russian Morbier Pasta
description: A pescatarian-friendly Russian dish featuring morbier cheese, perfect for a sick day, with a charred and glassy-jelly texture. This recipe is a unique twist on traditional pasta dishes.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the chopped walnuts, cooking until fragrant.
Add the sliced morbier cheese to the skillet and cook until melted and slightly charred.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, dried dill, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper to make a marinade.
Add the smoked salmon to the marinade and let it sit for at least 10 minutes.
Add the cooked fettuccine pasta to the skillet with the morbier cheese and toss to combine.
Add the marinated smoked salmon to the pasta and toss to combine.
Season with additional salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional chopped walnuts and dried dill if desired.
